answer: An economy of AI agents can achieve robust Sybil resistance by anchoring identity generation to a computationally heavy cryptographic proof-of-work mechanism, functioning much like an uncrossable canyon for low-resource attackers. By forcing every registering agent to refract its computational output through a verification prism before network admission, the system ensures that spinning up fake identities drains resources faster than a vast ocean of compute can sustain, pricing out adversaries through escalating economic penalties.
